Name: Skateboard
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod is gnarly, dude.

[youtube]uNPrgXEMNCs[/youtube]

Don't forget your brain buckets, posers!

[i]Disclaimer: I am not a skateboarder.[/i]


[size=5][b]Getting a Board[/b][/size]

You can like craft a complete in the totally radical crafting menu using:

[list]
[*]4 Hardwood (for the custom maple deck)
[*]1 Iridium Bar (for bodacious bearings)
[*]1 Iron Bar (for truck, coping, etc.)
[*]1 Refined Quartz (for grip tape)
[*]10 Sap (for risers, wheels, grip tape)
[/list]
You can also type [b]skateboard[/b] into the SMAPI console to get a complete board for free - excellent!


[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]

To ride, hold a complete board and press the ride button (default [b]Right Mouse[/b]). To bail, press the ride button again.

If you get stuck on something, bail.

I recommend using this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6546]Yet Another Jump Mod[/url], both for performing wicked techs and for getting unstuck.

This mod sometimes ignores collisions with removable objects, let's just call it a feature.


[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]

You can totally change not only the above most excellent requirements in the config, but also max speed, acceleration, deceleration, and the ride button.


[size=5][b]Custom Boards[/b][/size]

You can change the board texture (found at [b]assets/board.png[/b]) using Content Patcher and targeting the following path:

[b]aedenthorn.Skateboard/Board[/b]

Custom Boards that work with this mod include:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13100]Back to the Future Hoverboard skin[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13116]Simple Skateboard Retextures[/url]﻿

[/list]

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
